name: GeeCee Ventures Limited
summary: GeeCee Ventures Limited engages in the real estate development, renewable energy, and financial service businesses in India. It operates through Real Estate, Financing Services, and Others segments. The company develops residential and commercial projects. It also invests in surplus funds of the company in equity instruments, risk free inter-corporate deposits, and other interest-bearing financial instruments, as well as wind power generation. The company was formerly known as Gwalior Chemical Industries Limited and changed its name to GeeCee Ventures Limited in January 2010. GeeCee Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
